description: This file is the main FastAPI application setup for a Todo REST API, defining routes, health checks, and middleware configuration.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema on application startup, handling exceptions to maintain service availability.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint that reports system and database status.

methods.name: List[TodoOut] list_todos()
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all Todo items from the database.

methods.name: TodoOut create_todo(payload: TodoCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new Todo item with validated input data.

methods.name: TodoOut get_todo( todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Numeric identifier of the todo"), )
methods.description: Fetches a specific Todo by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: TodoOut replace_todo( payload: TodoUpdate, todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Identifier of the todo"), )
methods.description: Replaces an existing Todo entirely with provided data; raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: TodoOut patch_todo( payload: TodoUpdate, todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Identifier of the todo"), )
methods.description: Partially updates a Todo item with provided fields; raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: None delete_todo( todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Identifier of the todo"), )
methods.description: Deletes a Todo by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

ctags.signature: ( todo_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Identifier of the todo"), )
